metadata.question: Did Donner Pass have over 40 inches of snow water equivelent in January to April, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about snow water equivalent (SWE) at Donner Pass from January to April 2022, specifically if it had over 40 inches. 1. **Search Strategy**: - Dataset: I should use MODIS snow cover products or similar that provide SWE data. The MODIS/Terra Snow Cover Daily L3 Global dataset might work, but let me check what's available. Actually, the MODIS Snow Water Equivalent (MOD10A1) or similar would be better. - Location: Donner Pass coordinates are approximately 39.3166°N, 120.3259°W - Time: January 1, 2022 to April 30, 2022 2. **Data Quality & Logic**: - Need to check if collection has data - Need to validate pixel counts after processing - Convert SWE from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) 3. **Processing**: - I'll use MODIS/Terra Snow Cover Daily L3 Global 500m SIN Grid V061 (MOD10A1.061) which has 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' but might need alternative for SWE - Actually, let me use the MODIS/Terra Snow Water Equivalent Daily L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG (MOD10C1.061) which has 'Snow_Water_Equivalent' - Convert from mm to inches and check if maximum or average exceeds 40 inches Let me structure this: - Define Donner Pass geometry - Get MOD10C1 collection for Jan-Apr 2022 - Check collection size - Process SWE data and convert to inches - Calculate statistics and determine answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const donnerPass = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.3259, 39.3166]); const startDate = '2022-01-01'; const endDate = '2022-04-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Snow Water Equivalent const collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10C1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(donnerPass); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Convert SWE from mm to inches const sweInInches = collection.map(function(image) { return image.select('Snow_Water_Equivalent') .multiply(0.0393701); // Convert mm to inches }); // Calculate maximum SWE during the period const maxSWE = sweInInches.max(); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats = maxSWE.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: donnerPass, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const sweValue = stats.get('Snow_Water_Equivalent').getInfo(); const pixelCount = maxSWE.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: donnerPass, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Snow_Water_Equivalent').getInfo(); console.log(`Max SWE (inches): ${sweValue ? sweValue.toFixed(2) : 'No data'}`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (sweValue === null || sweValue === undefined || isNaN(sweValue)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (sweValue > 40) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
